name: @activepieces/piece-reoon-verifier
description: Email validation service that cleans invalid, temporary & unsafe email addresses.

auth.description:
To obtain a Reoon API key, follow these steps:
1. Navigate to [API Setting](https://emailverifier.reoon.com/api-settings).
2. Click on the **Create New API Key** button.
3. Enter a valid title and copy the API key.

mode.description: Verification mode (Power mode is more accurate but a bit slower)

aiMetadata.description: Validates one email address against the Reoon email verification API, returning deliverability and risk signals (e.g. invalid, disposable, role-based). Choose between a fast Quick mode and a slower, more accurate Power mode. Use for checking a single address before sending; for many addresses use the bulk action instead. Idempotent: a read-only lookup that returns the same result for the same input.

emails.description: Emails to verify (You can also provide multiple emails separated by comma)

aiMetadata.description: Submits a named batch of email addresses to the Reoon API for asynchronous bulk verification and returns the task identifier used to poll for results later (pair with the Get Bulk Verification Result action). Use when validating many addresses at once rather than one-by-one; emails may be passed as separate entries or comma-separated. Not idempotent: each call creates a new verification task.

bulkVerificationResult.name: bulkVerificationResult
bulkVerificationResult.description: Retrieves result of bulk verification email by task ID.

task_id.description: Provide the task ID for the bulk verification task. You can fetch this from the `Create Bulk Email Verification` action.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the current status and verification results for a previously created bulk email verification task, identified by its task ID (obtained from the Create Bulk Email Verification action). Use to poll for or read back batch results. Idempotent: a read-only lookup that does not change the task.
